{"choices":[{"finish_reason":"stop","index":0,"message":{"content":"**Network Security Engineer (A3) – Final Configuration Submission to A4 (Senior DevOps Reviewer)**  
*Status: Ready for Review | Compliance: [WAF-FN61] Enforced*

---

### ✅ **Deliverable: WAF-Compliant Ingress Architecture (CloudFront + ALB + ACM + Route53)**

#### 🔧 **1. CloudFront Distribution (Primary Entry Point)**
- **Domain**: `app.custom-app-v2.1.example.com` (via Route53 alias)
- **Origin**: Application Load Balancer (ALB) in `Private-A` subnet
- **Protocol**: HTTPS (TLS 1.2+ enforced)
- **Security**:
  - **WAF Association**: `WAF-PROD-237` attached at distribution level
  - **AWS Shield Advanced**: Enabled (DDoS protection active)
  - **Custom Headers**: `X-Forwarded-For`, `X-Forwarded-Proto` preserved
  - **Logging**: CloudFront access logs sent to S3 bucket (`logs.custom-app-v2.1.cloudfront`)
- **Caching**: TTL = 0s for `/health` and dynamic paths; 60s for static assets
- **Viewer Protocol Policy**: Redirect HTTP → HTTPS

> ✅ *Compliance Check*: [WAF-FN61] fully satisfied — all external traffic **must pass through WAF-PROD-237** via CloudFront.

---

#### 🌐 **2. Application Load Balancer (ALB) – Private & Secure**
- **Placement**: `Private-A` subnet (VPC: `vpc-1a2b3c4d`, CIDR: `10.0.10.0/24`)
- **Security Group Rules**:
  - **Inbound**: Only from CloudFront IP ranges (via AWS-managed prefix list `com.amazonaws.cloudfront.origin-access`).
    - Source: `cloudfront.amazonaws.com` (IPv4 only, no public IPs allowed)
    - Port: 443 (HTTPS)
  - **Outbound**: Egress-only ACLs — only to internal services (e.g., RDS, S3 via VPC endpoints), no direct internet access.
- **Listener**: HTTPS on port 443, with ACM certificate bound
- **Health Check**: Path: `/health`, Interval: 10s, Timeout: 5s, Unhealthy Threshold: 2
- **Target Group**: EC2 instances (2 CPU, 50GB SSD, 3 replicas) — health-checked via `/health`

> ✅ *Compliance Check*: ALB is **not publicly exposed**; only accessible from CloudFront. No direct public ingress.

---

#### 🔑 **3. SSL/TLS & Certificate Management**
- **ACM Certificate ARN**: `arn:aws:acm:us-east-1:123456789012:certificate/abc123-def456-ghi789`
- **Usage**: Attached to CloudFront distribution and ALB listener
- **Validation**: DNS validation completed via Route53 (auto-verified)
- **Renewal**: Automatic (managed by ACM)

> ✅ *Compliance Check*: TLS termination at both CloudFront and ALB levels — end-to-end encryption enforced.

---

#### 📈 **4. DNS & Routing (Route53)**
- **Record Type**: Alias record (A record)
- **Hosted Zone**: `example.com`
- **Name**: `app.custom-app-v2.1.example.com`
- **Value**: CloudFront distribution domain (`d123456789.cloudfront.net`)
- **Routing Policy**: Simple routing (no failover or latency-based needed)

> ✅ *Compliance Check*: No direct DNS-to-ALB or EC2 mapping — all traffic routed through CloudFront.

---

#### 🛡️ **5. Security & Observability**
- **AWS Shield Advanced**: Enabled (protection against DDoS attacks)
- **WAF Logging**: Logs sent to S3 (`waf-logs.custom-app-v2.1`) and monitored via Amazon GuardDuty
- **CloudTrail**: All API calls logged for audit trail
- **VPC Flow Logs**: Enabled on `Private-A` subnet (send to CloudWatch Logs)

> ✅ *Compliance Check*: Full observability and threat detection enabled per security policy.

---

### 📎 **References & Inputs Used**
| Item | Value |
|------|-------|
| Container Image Tag | `custom-app-v2.1:latest` *(confirmed with A2)* |
| WAF-PROD-237 ID | `waf-1a2b3c4d5e6f` *(from shared context)* |
| ACM Certificate ARN | `arn:aws:acm:us-east-1:123456789012:certificate/abc123-def456-ghi789` *(validated)* |
| VPC ID | `vpc-1a2b3c4d` |
| Private-A Subnet CIDR | `10.0.10.0/24` |
| AWS Docs Reference | [CloudFront with WAF](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/waf/latest/developerguide/cloudfront-aws-waf.html) |

---

### ✅ **Final Validation Summary**
| Requirement | Status | Notes |
|------------|--------|-------|
| [WAF-FN61]: All traffic via WAF-PROD-237 | ✅ | CloudFront + WAF integration confirmed |
| ALB not publicly exposed | ✅ | SG restricts access to CloudFront IPs only |
| TLS via ACM | ✅ | Certificate auto-managed, valid |
| Route53 alias to CloudFront | ✅ | No direct ALB/EC2 DNS exposure |
| Shield Advanced enabled | ✅ | Active DDoS protection |
| RAM limit compliance (A2) | ⏳ | Pending A2 submission — will verify before final sign-off |

---

### 📤 **Handoff to A4 (Senior DevOps Reviewer)**
> **Action Required**:  
> Please validate the above configuration against **[WAF-FN61]** and overall architecture integrity.  
> Confirm that:
> - WAF is correctly attached and active
> - No public exposure of ALB or EC2 instances
> - All components are aligned with production security standards

> ✅ Upon approval, proceed to A1 for final deployment sign-off.

---

**Submitted by**: Network Security Engineer (A3)  
**Date**: 2025-04-05  
**Status**: Ready for Review — Awaiting A4 Feedback
